name: LDL cholesterol
rangeNote: Targets depend on your overall heart risk. People at higher risk are often advised to aim much lower.
summary: LDL carries cholesterol in the blood. Over time, high LDL levels contribute to plaque in artery walls.

high.meaning: A high LDL raises the long-term risk of heart attack and stroke, especially together with other risk factors.

low.meaning: A low LDL is generally linked with lower heart risk.

sources.title: 2019 ESC/EAS Guidelines for the management of dyslipidaemias: lipid modification to reduce cardiovascular risk
